summary: Add server-side literal text filters to CLI listings before pagination

replay.detail: No claim replay, startup backfill, or new materialization. Filtering uses existing current projections and list readers; their historical cold-read costs remain.

schema.detail: Additive optional filter query and collection subscription field, filter acknowledgment on client pages, and filter binding in continuation tokens. No database tables, indexes, migrations, or stored claim changes.

rules.detail: Existing actor visibility, session authorization, canonical selection and closed/reminder membership apply before filtered results. A filter or cursor grants no authority.

compatibility.detail: Every ls command accepts --filter TEXT up to 256 UTF-8 bytes, a case-insensitive literal substring of projected id/name/title. Filtered pages and continuation use the same filter. Filtered pagination instructions move to stderr. Existing unfiltered CLI and cursor membership remain; newly filtered HTTP SDK calls refuse older servers that omit the filter acknowledgment.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon/CLI rollout. Register the pure matcher once when each reader connection opens; no startup scans or required downtime.

manual.detail: Deploy the supporting server before using filtered HTTP SDK listings. Use --filter instead of piping the first page to grep; repeat the shell-quoted filter with continuation.

recovery.detail: Existing page expiry/restart and authorization behavior remain. Changing a filter during continuation is refused; restart the filtered listing.
